build.command: xcodebuild -project Strand.xcodeproj -scheme NOOPiOS -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=<simulator-udid>' -derivedDataPath <capture-root>/DerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath <capture-root>/SourcePackages CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES build

captureEnvironment.rendering: Full-resolution PNG copies with no crop, compositing, retouching, or color correction

seeded.name: AppleDemoSeeder
seeded.description: DEBUG-only deterministic 120-day synthetic health and fitness fixture. It contains no real biometric data.

empty.name: Fresh local store
empty.description: Brand-new disposable simulator with no seed and no imported or real health data. Used to preserve Building, Calibrating, and missing-value states.

matrix.result: 21 scenario artifacts launched and captured; the harness manifest contained 21 unique device/scenario rows

assets.command: xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process <fresh-simulator-udid> com.noopapp.noop -theme.appearance dark --demo-screen liquidtoday
assets.setup: Created a disposable iPhone 17 Pro on the newest installed iOS runtime, booted it to completion, fixed the status bar, and installed the exact-head DEBUG app before launch; the simulator was deleted after capture.

limitations: Simulator captures do not validate physical-band BLE behavior, background execution, haptics, battery behavior, firmware, or sensor accuracy.
Synthetic fixture values and charts demonstrate rendering and navigation only; they are not clinical evidence or production-user results.
The empty-state capture intentionally preserves Building, Calibrating, dashes, and missing values instead of replacing them with idealized scores.
Android and macOS are omitted because this slice did not run an exact-head deterministic capture exporter for those platforms.
No owner comparison image, visible terminal, competitor visual, real health data, provisional marketing screenshot, old docs/assets shot-* asset, or hero-v8 asset was used.
